ios.desc:
Soro provides modern, intuitive user interface to control your speakers, extends your iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Siri AI, Control Center and Home Screen widgets, Live Activities and 30+ powerful Shortcuts actions. Soro lets you create both quick actions or extensive workflows to control your speakers with the Shortcuts app using widgets, Siri voice commands or automations. 

▶ Browse Your Music
* Support for Music Services that you already added in the Sonos app
* Browse your Sonos Music Library
* Extended Apple Music Integration:
    * Add tracks, albums to your Apple Music playlists or favourites (in-app and via Shortcuts action)
    * Play artist stations
    * See additional details of albums and artists, such as related items and notes

▶ Shortcuts & Automations
* 30+ actions to control your speakers and automate the settings in the Shortcuts app
* Build quick actions or extensive automations or integrate with other third-party apps
* Start creating shortcuts in the Shortcuts app or use one the of examples included in Soro as a starting point
* Use the actions to 
- Play music from any of your music services, favorites, playlist, 
- Broadcast a message
- See what's playing
- Change volume, adjust the EQ, home theatre settings such as speech enhancement and night mode, subwoofer and surround options
- Manage the music queue
- Select input
- Control playback
- Manage speaker grouping
- Load sound preset
- Control you alarms

▶ Search
* Efficiently search and filter across your Sonos Favorites, Sonos Playlists, Sonos Music Library, and connected music services
* Search directly from Siri AI: “Find the album Get Mean by Boy Harsher in Soro”

▶ Home Screen Widgets
* Now Playing: View current Sonos playback details, pick/configure rooms, adjust volume, play/pause, skip
* Quick Access: Jump into search, open queue/EQ/grouping or music services
* Collections: Quick access to items in your favourite collections

▶ Lock Screen Control and Dynamic Island
* Soro is now integrated with the system media controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center to allow better integration with system features such using the hardware buttons for volume control.

▶ Control Center Widgets
* Quickly change your speaker settings or instantly open the app to a specific view from the Control Center.
* All available speaker settings, such as volume, EQ parameters, etc. can be adjusted by adding and configuring an instance of the Sonos Settings widget
